item.title: Thirty-six years after Polytechnique attack killing 14 women, a duty to do more
item.description: MONTREAL — Montrealers and others across the country paused to pay tribute Saturday to the 14 women who were murdered at Polytechnique Montréal 36 years ago simply because they were women. The prime minister acknowledged there was much left to do.

item.title: Wolf's 28-save shutout leads Calgary Flames to 2-0 win over Utah Mammoth
item.description: CALGARY — Dustin Wolf made 28 saves for his fifth career shutout to lead the Calgary Flames to a 2-0 NHL victory over the Utah Mammoth on Saturday Yegor Sharangovich and Connor Zary, into an empty net, scored for Calgary (11-15-4).

item.title: Texier scores shootout winner, Montreal Canadiens top Toronto Maple Leafs 2-1
item.description: TORONTO — Alexandre Texier scored the shootout winner as the Montreal Canadiens topped the Toronto Maple Leafs 2-1 on Saturday night. Cole Caufield, who also scored in the shootout, also had a goal in regulation for Montreal (15-9-3).

item.title: Hofer's 41 saves lifts St. Louis Blues to 2-1 win over Ottawa Senators
item.description: OTTAWA — Joel Hofer made 41 saves and the St. Louis Blues held off a late rally from the Ottawa Senators to take a 2-1 win Saturday.

item.title: Alberta's Smith says courts should not be gatekeepers on constitutional questions
item.description: EDMONTON — Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says anyone seeking an independence referendum should not have "gatekeepers," like the courts, standing in their way.

item.title: 'It hurts': MLS Cup loss painful for Müller, Vancouver Whitecaps
item.description: The Vancouver Whitecaps' fairy tale season came to a disappointing end with a 3-1 loss to Lionel Messi and Inter Miami.

item.title: United States blanks Canada 2-0 in Para Hockey Cup final
item.description: DAWSON CREEK — Canada fell 2-0 to the United States in the Para Hockey Cup final Saturday. Brett Bolton scored in the first period and Brody Roybal added an empty-net goal for the U.S., which is the reigning world and Paralympic champion.

item.title: A fire at a popular nightclub in India's Goa state kills at least 25, officials say
item.description: NEW DELHI (AP) — At least 25 people, including tourists, were killed in a fire at a popular nightclub in India’s Goa state, the state’s chief minister said Sunday. The blaze occurred just past midnight in Arpora in North Goa, a party hub.

item.title: Four goals in the first period spur Edmonton Oilers to 6-2 win over Winnipeg Jets
item.description: EDMONTON — Leon Draisaitl and Evan Bouchard each had a goal and an assist for the Edmonton Oilers in a 6-2 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Saturday. The Oilers exploded out of the gate to take a 4-0 lead after the first period.

item.title: Raty scores twice for Vancouver Canucks in 4-2 win over Minnesota Wild
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks scored three times in the second period en route to a 4-2 win over the Minnesota Wild on Saturday. Aatu Raty scored twice for Vancouver (11-15-3), which halted a four-game skid.
